entries.reason: #590 (99773a83) rewrote this test to read the object header through the sanctioned ESHKOL_GET_HEADER accessor and eshkol_object_header_t instead of a hand-rolled parallel header struct, so the parallel-declaration site it used to carry is gone. The remaining A_macro_api/B_header_type/G_header_field_write sites the same commit added are legitimate, sanctioned header access and are captured by re-running `baseline`.

tests/fuzz/eskm_model_fuzz_probe.cpp is compiled only when ESHKOL_ENABLE_FUZZ=ON, so its nine deliberate header accesses (a seeded probe that must touch the object header by design) appear in the clang-layer scan of a fuzz-enabled build and are absent from every other compile set. The baseline carries the superset; a non-fuzz build sees each class drop from 3 to 0, which is this conditional compile, not a migration.

SW-197 / ADR-0020 amendment 2: the tensor collection walker stores each leaf through eshkol_tensor_slot_store instead of classifying rational/bignum leaves itself, so its private ESHKOL_GET_HEADER read in coll_leaf_double is gone; the slot store boundary's own header read covers it.

make-string moved into this file (eshkol_make_string_checked); rather than add a fourth call of arena_allocate_string_with_header, every string allocation of the file now goes through one helper, eshkol_string_buffer, leaving the extern declaration and that helper as the only header-aware sites.
